title: Trace a Produce From Client to Last Replica
description:
**SITUATION:**

KRaft cluster is up. `rider.dispatch` is live — leave its shape alone. Dispatch wants one keyed status line in the topic so you can prove the write path end to end: client → partition → leader → followers → log end on every replica.

A note under `~/ticket/` names the key and value to produce. Use `$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS` from the shell environment.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Open the **Guide**. Produce the keyed record into `rider.dispatch` with `acks=all`.
2. Find which partition the key hashed to, which broker leads that partition, and which brokers are in the ISR.
3. Read the log-end offset for that partition (same on every in-sync replica after `acks=all`).
4. Fill every Investigation field. Do not create or delete topics.

**SPEC:**

- The Investigation matches the live partition map and offsets for the record you produced.
- `rider.dispatch` still has 6 partitions, RF 3, min.ISR 2.

hints: Open the Guide. Produce with kafka-console-producer.sh and --property parse.key=true.
kafka-topics.sh --describe --topic rider.dispatch shows Leader and Isr per partition.
kafka-get-offsets.sh --topic rider.dispatch --time -1 shows the log end (high watermark) per partition.
Fill the Investigation tab — missing answers fail on Submit.

problemStatement.guide:
# QuickBite Data Platform — trace one produce (KRaft)

| Host      | Role                                     |
|-----------|------------------------------------------|
| `kafka-0` | Combined broker + controller (node id 1) |
| `kafka-1` | Combined broker + controller (node id 2) |
| `kafka-2` | Combined broker + controller (node id 3) |
| `shell`   | CLI (`BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS`)                |

Leave topic shapes alone. This lab is one keyed write into `rider.dispatch`.

## 1. Read the ticket

```bash
less ~/ticket/PRODUCE.md
```

## 2. Produce with acks=all

From the **shell**, using `$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS`:

```bash
printf '%s\n' 'ride-9917:{"status":"assigned"}' | \
  kafka-console-producer.sh \
    --bootstrap-server "$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" \
    --topic rider.dispatch \
    --property parse.key=true \
    --property key.separator=: \
    --producer-property acks=all
```

## 3. Map key → partition → leader → ISR

```bash
kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server "$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" \
  --describe --topic rider.dispatch
```

Find the partition for `ride-9917` (or use `kafka-topics` / a short consumer with `print.key`). Then record **Leader** and **Isr** for that partition.

Hint — print which partition received the key:

```bash
kafka-console-consumer.sh --bootstrap-server "$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" \
  --topic rider.dispatch --from-beginning --property print.key=true \
  --property print.partition=true --property print.offset=true \
  --timeout-ms 10000 | grep ride-9917
```

## 4. Log end on the partition

```bash
kafka-get-offsets.sh --bootstrap-server "$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" \
  --topic rider.dispatch --time -1
```

After `acks=all`, every in-sync replica has caught up to that end offset.

## 5. Investigation

Record bootstrap source, key, partition, leader broker id, ISR (sorted ascending), and the log-end offset. Then Submit.
